source_quote: Determine the quality points of all courses taken
answer: Cumulative GPA (CGPA): determine the quality points of all courses taken, add the total quality points and the corresponding credit hours, then divide total quality points by total credit hours.

source_quote: The minimum passing letter grade is D.
answer: RHU uses numeric grades converted to letter grades; the minimum passing letter grade is D (numeral 60 to below 65). Below 60 is F (fail).

source_quote: D+ 1.85 Minimal Pass
answer: Grading scale (numeral / letter / value): ≥95 A+ 4 (Distinguished); 90-<95 A 3.85 (Excellent); 85-<90 B+ 3.75 (Very Good); 80-<85 B 3.40 (Good); 77-<80 C+ 3.00 (Fair); 73-<77 C 2.70 (Average); 70-<73 C- 2.35 (Satisfactory); 65-<70 D+ 1.85 (Minimal Pass); 60-<65 D 1.25 (Weak); <60 F 0 (Fail).

source_quote: PH Pass with Honor
answer: Other grade designations: I = Incomplete, P = Passing grade, PH = Pass with Honor, W = Withdrawal, WE = Excused withdrawal, CIP = Course in progress, CR = Credit Granted.

source_quote: To be eligible for a mention on the honor list, a student must
answer: To appear on an honor list, a student must be full-time, have no F grade in any course, have no incomplete grades, and not have been subject to disciplinary action.

source_quote: Students whose semester GPA (SGPA) is 85 or above shall be placed on the Dean’s
answer: Students meeting the honor conditions with a semester GPA of 85 or above are placed on the Dean's Honor List (commendation from the College Dean); those with 90 or above are placed on the President's Honor List (commendation from the President).

source_quote: Students graduating with a cumulative GPA (CGPA) of 85 or above shall receive the
answer: Graduates with a CGPA of 85 or above receive 'Distinction' and those with 90 or above receive 'High Distinction', provided they meet the general honor conditions; the designation appears on the graduation certificate and official transcript.

source_quote: Hariri Graduate Study Award. The award is a full-tuition scholarship to pursue a master’s
entity: Nazik Rafik Hariri Graduate Study Award
answer: The two graduating students with the highest GPA in the College of Business Administration and the College of Engineering receive the Nazik Rafik Hariri Graduate Study Award: a full-tuition scholarship for a master's degree at RHU.

source_quote: With the academic advisor's approval, a student may drop one or more courses during
answer: With the academic advisor's approval, a student may drop courses during the drop/add period; no record of dropped courses appears on the student's record.

source_quote: courses between the second and the tenth week of classes of a regular semester or
answer: With advisor approval, a student may withdraw from courses between the 2nd and 10th week of a regular semester (2nd-6th week of summer) provided the load (excluding summer) stays at 12 credits or more; dean approval is needed if it falls below 12. A W grade is recorded and counts as a course attempt for the repeat policy.

source_quote: Students who withdraw from classes after the drop period are responsible for all related
answer: Students who withdraw from classes after the drop period remain responsible for all related tuition and fees.

source_quote: Formal Withdrawal. In verifiably difficult circumstances, a student may petition to
answer: In verifiably difficult circumstances, a student may petition to withdraw from all courses any time after drop/add and before final exams; the College Dean may approve after consultation. Each course gets a WE grade, which does not count as a course attempt, and the student may register normally the next semester.

source_quote: Informal Withdrawal. Suppose a student withdraws from the semester without following
answer: A student who leaves the semester without following withdrawal procedures receives an F in every registered course, counted as attempts. To return, college approval is required; if convincing evidence shows reasons beyond the student's control, the Fs are replaced by WE, which are excluded from GPA and not counted as attempts.

source_quote: A withdrawn student may only transfer credits for courses s/he has studied at another
answer: A withdrawn student may transfer credits for courses studied elsewhere during the withdrawal period only with prior approval from the concerned college.

source_quote: Students who wish to withdraw from the University are required to complete established
answer: Students who wish to withdraw from the University must complete the established clearance procedures.

source_quote: During the first week of a semester, a student may petition for a leave of absence (LOA)
answer: During the first week of a semester, a student may petition for a leave of absence of one or two consecutive semesters by submitting the Continuous Enrollment Registration Form to the Dean and paying a USD 20 LOA fee per semester on leave.

source_quote: Students may accrue up to 3 semesters of LOA while pursuing a degree. The LOA
answer: Students may accrue up to 3 semesters of LOA during their degree; LOA semesters count toward the maximum allowed study deferment. Students returning right after an approved LOA register normally; those returning later must seek reinstatement from the college and follow the study plan and catalog in effect at re-enrollment.

source_quote: A student on an approved LOA may transfer credits only for courses s/he studies at other
answer: A student on approved leave of absence may transfer credits for courses studied at other institutions only with prior approval from the concerned college.

source_quote: The Special Enrollment (SE) status applies to a student who has completed course
answer: Special Enrollment (SE) is for a student who completed course requirements but must remain active for a legitimate reason. The student submits the Continuous Enrollment Registration Form (approved by advisor, chair, and dean) to the Registrar before the end of drop/add and pays USD 20 per semester (plus USD 10 penalty if paid outside the regular period). Not registering as SE requires reapplying for readmission.

source_quote: A student who is not on track to earn a specific degree at RHU but wishes to register for
answer: A student who is not pursuing a specific RHU degree but wants to register for courses they are eligible to take may do so as a non-degree student.

source_quote: Study a double major concurrently;
answer: RHU options for further studies: a double major studied concurrently, two degrees earned simultaneously, or returning after graduation for a second degree.

source_quote: Students may concurrently study two majors within the same college that share similar
answer: A double major is two majors in the same college with similar degree structures. Students in good standing who completed at least 24 credits in the first major may apply if they meet the second major's admission requirements; they must complete at least 24 credits of core courses in the second major, including all its mandatory core courses. One diploma listing both majors is awarded; common courses count for both.

source_quote: Students may simultaneously pursue two different degrees from programs offered by
answer: Dual degrees are two degrees from different colleges with different structures. Students in good standing with at least 24 credits in the first major may apply if they meet the second degree's admission requirements. A diploma is granted for each degree once all requirements, including co-op, are met; common courses count for both, and the higher tuition rate applies.

source_quote: Students who have earned a degree and opt to return to the University at a later date to
answer: Graduates may return later for a second degree if they meet its admission requirements; they may be required to repeat courses taken more than three years ago or with low grades, as recommended by the second degree's department.

source_quote: Obtain a Minor Cumulative Grade Point Average of no less than 70%
answer: Students may pursue a minor outside their major if they keep a minor CGPA of at least 70%. Overlapping major/minor courses count toward the minor; a student may pursue up to two minors, with at most nine credits counted toward both minors.

source_quote: The permissible period of study deferment for a bachelor student, intentional or
answer: A bachelor student may defer study for at most six semesters (summer excluded). Exceeding this leads to dismissal; returning later requires reinstatement approved by the college, under the study plan and catalog in effect at reinstatement.

source_quote: A student who has completed at least one semester of coursework in a major may
answer: After at least one semester in a major, a student may request a change before the 13th week of a fall or spring semester. The decision considers: meeting admission requirements; seat availability; no previous change of major; and fewer than 64 earned credits in the old major (unless forced out for academic reasons). Required earned credits transfer to the new major and count in the CGPA.

source_quote: calculate the CGPA. However, if the student wishes, six credits may be deducted from
answer: When changing major, the student may choose to have six credits deducted from the CGPA calculation if moving within the same college, or up to twelve credits if moving to a new college.

source_quote: Intensive English Program students in IELP 095/100 Levels may request a major
answer: Intensive English students in IELP 095/100 may request a major reassignment before completing 15 credit hours; this is not considered a transfer or change of major.

source_quote: Support Centers, where you can seek help from your peers to overcome any difficulties
answer: RHU encourages students to communicate with instructors (in class, email, phone, social media, or Moodle) and to visit the Learning Support Centers for peer help with academic difficulties.

source_quote: Students receive academic probation if their CGPA falls below 70 after attempting at
answer: A student is placed on academic probation if their CGPA falls below 70 after attempting at least 24 credits, by the second or any later matriculated semester (summer excluded).

source_quote: Students with two consecutive probations may choose to:
answer: After two consecutive probations, a student may continue in the same major with College Council approval (risking critical standing after a third consecutive probation) or change major; if accepted, probation is removed when the CGPA of transferred courses is 70 or higher.

source_quote: A student may remove probation in a summer semester, but the results of that semester
answer: Probation can be removed in a summer semester, but summer results cannot place a student on probation. The Registrar reports students on probation to the colleges each semester.

source_quote: Course Load. Usually, the maximum study load for a student on probation is 12 credits
answer: A student on probation may usually take at most 12 credits (6 in summer); 13 (7 in summer) if one course is 4 credits or a required 1-credit lab; or 15 (9 in summer) if expected to graduate that semester, with dean approval.

source_quote: A student on probation shall be denied access to online registration and must
answer: Students on probation cannot register online and must register through their advisor. They must repeat at least two previously taken courses graded 70 or lower (three if probation continues) and repeat failed courses when first offered.

source_quote: Accrues three consecutive probations or four probations throughout the entire
answer: A student is placed in Critical Academic Standing (CAS) after three consecutive probations or four probations in total, or after attaining a CGPA below 60 more than once as a matriculated student.

source_quote: Resume studying in Good Standing if s/he attains a CGPA of 70 or higher;
answer: A CAS student must register (through the advisor only) for up to 15 credits of repeated courses previously graded 70 or lower or failed. At semester end, they return to good standing with a CGPA of 70+, continue on CAS with a semester GPA of 75+, or are otherwise dismissed from RHU.

source_quote: A student whose CGPA falls below 60 at the end of any semester after the first semester
answer: A student whose CGPA falls below 60 at the end of any semester after the first (at least 12 credits) must transfer to another program and cannot return to the old program.

source_quote: Acts of plagiarism, cheating on exams, or other types of work submitted for
answer: RHU forbids unauthorized use of others' work; plagiarism, cheating on exams, or dishonesty in other assessed work is subject to possible disciplinary action.

source_quote: Students formally enrolled at RHU may take up to 15 credit hours of courses at a
answer: Enrolled RHU students may take up to 15 credit hours at an accredited university in or outside Lebanon if they: are registered at RHU; have completed at least 30 credits at RHU; take courses equivalent to required major courses; get prior approval from the department chair and dean; earn the equivalent of 75 or better; and submit certified transcripts. Transferred credits do not count in the CGPA.

source_quote: Usually, students are not allowed to take courses elsewhere during the last two
answer: Students usually cannot take courses elsewhere in their last two semesters before graduation, though up to 7 credits may be allowed if not offered at RHU. Credits cannot be transferred for courses taken during a leave of absence or formal/informal withdrawal.

source_quote: Professors must
answer: Student records at the Registrar are confidential and accessible only to authorized personnel; professors must post exam results by student ID, not names. Advisors and academic administrators may access records for advising and decisions.

source_quote: Official transcripts may be issued to a third party only if a signed authorization
answer: Official transcripts (signed by the Registrar) go to third parties only with the student's signed authorization or a judicial order. Students may request an unofficial transcript or grade record after two weeks of grade posting, and can see their grades anytime on CampusVue.

source_quote: If students need to submit a petition, it must be initiated with the help of their advisor.
answer: Petitions are initiated with the advisor's help on the typed form; the advisor verifies the information, signs, and forwards it to the department chair. The transcript is attached when the decision depends on the student's record.

source_quote: Commencement exercises are held after the conclusion of the spring semester. Students
answer: Commencement is held after the spring semester; students who complete requirements in the summer or previous fall may also attend. Graduates who skip the ceremony can collect their diplomas at the Registrar's Office after the commencement date.

source_quote: Names on diplomas and degrees are spelled exactly as they appear on passports, as
answer: Names on diplomas are spelled exactly as on the passport (MoEHE requirement). If the passport name changes after admission, the student must submit certified evidence to the Registrar before graduation; otherwise the old name appears and cannot be changed later.
